access_key_scopes_help: A key may hold any subset of the owner's ceiling.
access_pick_user: Pick a user to see their keys, machines, tokens and accounts.
account_delete_help: Deleting "{name}" removes the identity and every provider credential under it. This cannot be undone.
account_emoji_hint: One emoji, shown wherever this account appears. Leave empty for a coloured letter square.
account_emoji_invalid: Enter a single emoji, or leave it empty.
account_section_env_help: Extra environment variables handed to every session launched on this account. Values are write-only.
account_section_identity_help: The name and emoji this account is shown under.
account_section_providers_help: Open one to edit its models, aliases, limits and settings.
accounts_adv_refresh_summary: Advanced: paste a refresh token instead
accounts_aliases_help: Map a logical name to the model this account launches (e.g. opus → claude-opus-4-8[1m]).
accounts_confirm_delete_account: Delete account "{name}" and all its provider credentials?
accounts_confirm_remove_provider: Remove the {provider} credential from "{name}"? The account and its other providers stay.
accounts_endpoint_help: Base URL, auth scheme and credential are write-only: leave them untouched to keep the stored values.
accounts_err_base_url_required: Base URL is required for a compatible endpoint
accounts_err_paste_code_first: Paste the code from claude.ai first
accounts_field_pool_weight_help: Relative plan size for the pool gauge: 1 by default, 4 for a plan four times bigger.
accounts_intro: Credentials sessions run through. Pooled accounts are interchangeable; failover only moves inside a pool.
accounts_models_help: Models this credential offers, with the label the pickers show. Leave empty to offer the catalog's own list.
accounts_move_help: Re-parent this credential onto another of this owner's accounts (e.g. merging "alice (anthropic)" + "alice (openai)" into one "alice"). Only accounts with a free {family} slot are listed.
accounts_next_step_hint: Models, aliases, limits and settings are configured after this on the account page.
accounts_no_codex_settings: No per-provider settings for Codex yet — model aliases and soft limits above are the available knobs.
accounts_oauth_code_placeholder: paste the code#state shown after authorizing
accounts_oauth_localhost_note: The browser tab will fail to load localhost:1455 — that's expected. Copy the full URL from its address bar and paste it above.
accounts_oauth_opened_chatgpt: Opened ChatGPT — authorize, then copy the localhost:1455 URL and paste it below
accounts_oauth_opened_claude: Opened claude.ai — authorize, then paste the code below
accounts_placeholder_credential: bearer / API key (blank for an open proxy)
accounts_rate_limits_help: Cap the account's shared gateway throughput across all its concurrent sessions. Over the limit, requests get a 429 with a Retry-After. Blank or 0 = unlimited. Most useful for a pay-per-token provider whose RPM/TPM tier every worker shares.
accounts_redirect_none_possible: No other account shares a provider family
accounts_soft_limits_help: Cap cctui's own share of each usage window (%). Over the cap, cctui's spawned workers get a 429 instead of consuming more — leaving headroom for your own Claude Code. Blank = no cap. A bypass ignores its window's cap when that window resets within that many minutes — the 7d window usually needs a much longer bypass than the 5h one.
anthropic_settings_help: Applied by the cctui gateway on every request from this credential, so no session can bypass or supply them.
anthropic_thinking_display_help: Claude Code always asks for "omitted", which strips the reasoning text and leaves only a replay signature. Choose "summarized" to receive readable thinking. Summary tokens bill as output tokens.
anthropic_thinking_display_unset: Leave as the client sends it
attachments_missing_dropped: {count} attachment(s) could not be restored; their references were removed from the prompt
bookmarks_delete_confirm: Delete this bookmark? The saved text is gone for good.
bookmarks_empty: No bookmarks yet — save a message from a conversation.
bookmarks_line_saved_title: Already bookmarked — open it in Bookmarks
bookmarks_no_wrapup: No assistant message to save yet.
bookmarks_note_hint: Optional — why this is worth keeping.
composer_cache_cold: Prompt cache is cold — the next send re-bills the full context
composer_cache_cold_burst: Prompt cache is cold — the next send re-writes ~{tokens} tokens to cache
composer_cache_imminent: Prompt cache goes cold soon — send now to keep it warm
conversation_acct_bindings_desc: Each provider this conversation carries is bound to an account. Switch any of them — the conversation keeps its history; only the upstream account changes.
conversation_acct_no_bindings: This session has no gateway account bindings.
conversation_acct_none: No other same-provider account is available to switch to.
conversation_acct_soft_desc: cctui's share of this account's usage window is at its cap. Continue this chat on another account — the conversation keeps its history; only the upstream account changes.
conversation_auto_approve_aria: Auto-approve tool-use permissions — tool use only, plans still ask
conversation_auto_approve_title: Auto-approve tool-use permission requests for this session — tool use only, plans still ask
conversation_brief_jump: Jump to this message in the transcript
conversation_diagnose_title: Everything the daemon knows about this session, dated
conversation_edit_message_title: Pull this message back into the composer to edit and resend
conversation_edit_pending_title: Pull this still-pending message back into the composer to edit and resend
conversation_file_daemon_offline: Cannot open {name}: the machine is offline
conversation_file_denied: Cannot open {name}: the path is outside what the machine allows
conversation_file_not_found: Cannot open {name}: file not found on the machine
conversation_file_too_large: Cannot open {name}: the file is over the 32 MiB limit
conversation_model_unconfirmed: Model change sent — no confirmation yet
conversation_pin_title: Pin this message and jump back to it later
conversation_save_image_title: Save this message as an image
conversation_terminal_title: Read-only live view of the session's terminal
diagnose_codex_silence_auth: Auth posture is not the gateway-bound one: {state}.
diagnose_codex_silence_no_turn: No turn is in flight, so codex has nothing to answer.
diagnose_codex_silence_none: Nothing obviously wrong: the session looks idle by choice.
diagnose_codex_silence_not_live: No live app-server child owns this session.
diagnose_codex_silence_shared_dropped: The shared app-server connection dropped {count} in-flight request(s), last {age} ago.
diagnose_codex_silence_shared_no_frames: No JSON-RPC frames on the shared app-server connection: inventory, history and lifecycle traffic is not flowing.
diagnose_codex_silence_stalled_rpc: {count} JSON-RPC request(s) outstanding and no frame for {age}.
diff_help_base: j/k line · n/p hunk · ]/[ file · o expand/fold
diff_huge_explanation: This PR exceeds the large-diff threshold; GitHub serves it unreliably, so only the first {files} files are loaded. Open individual files on GitHub for the rest.
diff_truncated_note: This file's diff was too large to inline. Open it on GitHub to view the full change.
dispatch_account_hint: Routes the worker through the passthrough gateway under this account.
dispatch_binding_hint: A dispatch that names no account routes through this. A pool elects one of its members per dispatch, so a member that runs out is skipped instead of failing the job.
dispatch_enroll_hint: A dispatch with no explicit account routes its model traffic through the gateway under this account. An enrollment key is generated and shown once; configure your dispatcher binary with it so it can dial out.
dispatch_err_copy_failed: Could not copy — select and copy manually
dispatch_harness_claude_hint: Runs a claude worker via the control socket.
dispatch_harness_codex_hint: Runs headless codex exec in the worker.
dispatch_identity_hint: Which account the worker acts as. Empty = worker default.
dispatch_intro: Standalone executor services enrolled to your account. Each dials out to the server over a WebSocket and runs dispatched workers on its machine. Reference one by its name in {command}; a name here overrides a global dispatcher of the same name, for you only.
dispatch_key_reveal_hint: Copy this enrollment key now — it is shown only once and cannot be retrieved later. Configure your dispatcher binary with it.
dispatch_pack_ref_hint: Branch, tag or sha. Pin it in production.
dispatch_pack_subdir_hint: Subdirectory used as the pack root.
dispatch_pack_token_hint: HTTPS token for a private pack. Accepts vault: / k8s: refs; falls back to GITHUB_TOKEN.
dispatch_pack_url_hint: Git repo cloned into the worker at boot. Accepts the @ref and #subdir shorthand.
dispatch_prompt_file_hint: A file under the worker's /prompts. Overrides the inline prompt.
dispatch_prompt_placeholder: What should the worker do? (e.g. work on CCT-123 / a PR)
dispatch_ticket_hint: Issue id for the flow's context (e.g. an implement prompt).
dock_resize_grip: Drag to resize the panel; double-click to reset its width
drawer_change_model_title: Change model / effort for the next turn
drawer_copy_link_title: Copy a stable link to this session (paste in a PR — login-gated)
drawer_copy_markdown_title: Copy the whole conversation as Markdown (honors the view filters)
drawer_export_title: Download transcript as HTML (print it for a PDF)
drawer_fork_select_title: Pick messages, then fork a session from just that selection
drawer_fork_title: Fork into a new conversation (optionally change model)
drawer_no_inplace_model_title: Claude can't switch model in place — fork to change model
fireworks_affinity_help: Send the session id as `user` + `x-session-affinity` so a conversation's prompt prefix stays cache-warm on one replica.
fireworks_catalog_help: Model ids, display names and USD price per million tokens. Spawn resolves the model from this list — nothing hardcodes a model id.
fireworks_settings_help: Injected by the cctui gateway on every request to this credential. A value the client already sent always wins.
fork_after_here_title: Fork a new session keeping everything after this message
fork_cost: Your first message on the fork re-sends this conversation's history (~{tokens} tokens from the parent), so the opening turn re-bills that context.
fork_desc: Creates a new {target} seeded from this conversation's history. The original is left untouched. Adjust the model/effort below, or keep them to fork as-is.
fork_extract_below: after this message (keep everything below it)
fork_extract_desc: Seeds the new session with {label}. Tool calls without their results are trimmed so the branch resumes cleanly.
fork_extract_up_to: from this message (keep everything up to it)
fork_from_here_title: Fork a new session keeping everything up to and including this message
fork_select_message_title: Include this message in the fork selection
github_connectors_intro: Configure GitHub accounts one at a time. The credential is encrypted on the server and never shown again — only a masked preview.
github_credential_required: A credential is required for a new connector
github_field_new_credential: New credential (leave blank to keep current)
github_filter_placeholder: Filter PRs by title, repo, author…
github_no_connectors: No connectors yet. Add one to enable pull-request review.
github_no_pulls: No tracked pull requests yet. Add a connector and the reconcile poll will hydrate your inbox.
github_no_review_accounts_body: No GitHub connector is set up yet. Add one with a PAT to enable pull-request review.

github_review_prompt_load_failed: Could not load the review prompt; seeding PR context only

journey_do_hover: Hover the highlighted control to carry on.
journey_do_select: Choose an option to carry on.

journey_missing: That guide needs {needs} to walk you through.
journey_not_ready_machines_online: You need a machine online first.
journey_not_ready_sessions_live: You need a running session first.
journey_unavailable: That guide is not available right now.
limits_intro: Drag the bar to cap cctui's share of each window. Past the cap, workers get a 429 and leave headroom for your own Claude Code. Bypass lifts the cap for the last N minutes before the window resets.
login_passkey_failed: That passkey was not accepted. Try again, or sign in with your token.
login_subtitle: Enter an admin or user token to continue.
macros_confirm_body: A new session starts with this prompt and the macro's settings. It is archived on its own once it finishes cleanly.
macros_menu_empty: No macro yet — add one in Settings › Macros
nav_harness_mode_tooltip: Claude harness mode: {mode} — change in Settings (Codex sessions ignore this)
nav_notify_off_label: Notify me when a session needs input
nav_notify_unsupported: Notifications not supported in this browser
pools_delete_confirm: Delete this pool? Sessions running on it keep their account and simply stop being movable.
pools_draft_hint: Drag accounts here — an account belongs to one pool at a time
pools_draft_name_first: Name the pool, then drag accounts here or press Enter
pools_drop_refused: {name} can't be added to this pool
pools_failover_hint: When the bound account is refused mid-run, rebind the session to another member instead of letting it stall. Off by default; the move is always recorded on the session.
pools_member_withheld: its owner keeps it out of pools
pools_members_empty: No members. A pool with no accounts can serve nothing.
pools_owner_hint: A pool belongs to a user. The admin token has no identity of its own, so name the owner: only that user’s accounts can join.
pools_strategy_headroom_hint: Balances across the pool: each launch takes the member with the widest remaining margin.
pools_strategy_ordered_hint: A ladder: spend the first member, spill to the next only when it is out.
pools_usage_failover_off: Failover off: the projection only holds for new sessions
pools_usage_projection_detail: demand {demand} pt/h over a {hours} h base

providers_advanced_help_before: Paste a settings.json fragment to merge in additional allowlisted keys (e.g.
providers_catalog_load_failed: Could not load the settings catalog.
providers_env_intro: Arbitrary environment applied to every session run under this account. Stored encrypted; values are never shown again. Curated Claude Code knobs live on the provider's settings instead.
providers_env_replace_warning: On save, the stored environment is replaced with the rows below (empty = cleared).
providers_env_unchanged: Stored environment is left unchanged unless you edit a row.
providers_env_will_delete: On save, {names} will be deleted from the stored environment.
providers_header_pin_help: Show this credential's usage gauge in the header strip.
providers_raw_catalog_loading: Settings catalog is still loading — try again in a moment.
providers_raw_must_be_object: Settings must be a JSON object.
providers_settings_help: Applied to every session run under this provider. Curated settings and environment share one list; the server rejects org-managed keys.
providers_share_err_enter_user: Enter a user login or id
pull_no_file_changes: This pull request has no file changes.
queued_banner_body: This machine is over the RAM ceiling set for it, so the session has not started yet. It launches on its own, in queue order, as soon as the memory in use leaves room for it (checked every 30 seconds).
queued_confirm_discard_body: It leaves the queue and will never start.
queued_confirm_launch_body: The session starts right away even though the machine is over its RAM ceiling. The machine may run short of memory.
queued_inflight_body: The launch has been sent to the machine and cctui is waiting for it to confirm. The session appears here as soon as it starts.
queued_confirm_drop_body: This only removes the waiting request from cctui. If the machine did start the session, that session keeps running there: check the machine and stop it yourself if you do not want it.
queued_toast_dropped: Request dropped; anything already started on the machine keeps running
queued_confirm_relaunch_body: Only do this once you have checked the machine: if the session did start there, launching again creates a second one doing the same work.
queued_uncertain_body: The launch was interrupted while it was being sent ({why}), so nobody can tell whether this machine started it. Nothing is sent again on its own: check the machine, then launch it again if it did not start, or cancel it.
queued_reason: Waiting for RAM: the machine is over its ceiling
queued_toast_launch_conflict: Already launching, or cancelled in the meantime
resource_gauge_stale: Stale: no heartbeat for a few minutes.
resource_gauge_unknown: No figures yet: the daemon is too old to report them, or the machine has no /proc.
review_add_comment_title: Add a draft comment on this line
review_ask_agent_title: Ask the review agent about this line
review_center_unreachable: Could not reach the gh-review backend or mint an access token.
review_comment_placeholder: Leave a draft comment (Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to add)…
review_config_hint: Set {setting} in the deployment config to enable the gh-review integration.
review_promoted_answer: Promoted the answer to a draft on {block}
review_select_line_hint: Select a diff line and “Ask the agent” to discuss a block
search_bar_placeholder: Search — status:active machine:… label:… or free text
sessions_account_unobserved_tip: account: {name} — bound but no gateway traffic observed; the worker may be running on ambient credentials
sessions_activity_asleep_title: No tool activity for minutes — may be wedged
sessions_auto_approve_title: Auto-approve enabled — approves tool use without asking (tool use only, plans still ask)
sessions_confirm_archive_section: Archive all {count} sessions in {section}? You can undo from the toast.
sessions_edit_draft_body: The spawn form already has content. Replace it with this draft, or save it as its own draft first.
sessions_empty_sections: No sessions in the selected sections — toggle more from the section filter.
sessions_labels_empty_create: No labels yet — type to create one.
sessions_limit_reset_confirm_body: Redeem "{title}"? This consumes the reset and counts toward the weekly allowance.
sessions_limit_reset_unavailable: No limit reset available right now
sessions_rebinds_tip: This session changed accounts while running
sessions_search_live_only_hint: (live only — pick Archived to search all).
sessions_search_no_sections: No matches in the selected sections — toggle more from the section filter.
sessions_toast_current_saved_draft: Current form saved as a draft
sessions_toast_fork_slow: Forked conversation is taking a while to appear — it will show in the list shortly.
sessions_toast_not_found: Session not found — it may have been deleted.
sessions_toast_save_current_failed: Could not save the current form as a draft: {error}
sessions_token_cache_hint: ⚡ — cache read + create tokens, counted every turn. The whole context is re-read from cache each turn, so this accumulates ≈ window size × turns and dominates Σ. It is cumulative throughput, not current context occupancy.
sessions_token_cold_hint: Cache went cold — the next send re-bills the full context
sessions_token_cost_hint: $ — metered spend for this session, priced from the account's model catalog. Zero for accounts whose usage isn't priced per token.
sessions_token_in_hint: ↑ — new (uncached) input tokens, summed over the session. Small because each turn re-sends the bulk of the context as a cache read (⚡), not fresh input.
sessions_token_out_hint: ↓ — output (generated) tokens, summed over the session.
sessions_token_sum_hint: Σ — cumulative session usage (↑ + ↓ + ⚡), summed over every turn. This is lifetime billing-style throughput, NOT the current context size: ⚡ re-counts the cached context on each turn so Σ climbs well past what /context reports as loaded right now.
settings_account_names_help: Show the account name on each session row instead of the key icon. Useful when several accounts share one provider.
settings_admin_instance_name_help: Server-wide label shown as “cctui (NAME)” in the header and the browser tab, so several deployments stay telling apart. Empty (the default) shows the bare brand.
settings_appearance_desc: Theme, text size and language. The same settings are reachable from the header.
settings_archive_done_button_help: Show the archive-all control on the Completed group header. Per-session archive and the swipe gesture stay available either way.
settings_archive_shortcut_help: In an open conversation, ⌘ E (Mac) / Ctrl + E interrupts any running turn and archives the session.
settings_auto_resume_help: When a session stops on “API Error: Connection lost mid-response”, send it a “continue” after 1, 5 and 10 minutes, then give up and notify.
settings_execution_desc: How Claude sessions run on your machines. Applies to all your machines within ~1 s; Codex sessions ignore it.
settings_guides_description: Every guided tour in the app. Replay one whenever you like.
settings_guides_reset_confirm_message: Every guide goes back to not started and all earned XP is lost. This cannot be undone.
settings_guides_reset_help: Forget every guide's progress and show the welcome again.
settings_harness_bg_help: Full live fidelity with native FleetView — live PTY, mid-turn control.
settings_harness_oneshot_help: Ephemeral, per-turn. No live mid-turn control.
settings_instance_desc: This deployment: versions, updates, and what this browser keeps locally. The server-wide settings are admin-only.
settings_interface_language_help: Applies immediately and is saved to your account.
settings_list_width_help: How wide the session list is allowed to grow on a large screen. Narrower screens are unaffected.
settings_macros_enabled_help: Adds a ⚡ Macros button next to “New session”. Off by default.
settings_macros_field_confirm_help: Off = the macro starts on a single click.
settings_macros_field_model_help: Blank = the harness or account default.
settings_macros_field_pool_help: Auto lets the server pick the account with the most headroom.
settings_macros_incomplete: A title, a prompt, a machine and a working directory are required.
settings_macros_intro: A macro is a prompt with its own harness, machine, model, effort and pool, launched in one click from the ⚡ Macros menu of the Sessions screen. The session it starts is archived on its own once its turn ends cleanly; one that asks a question or fails stays listed.
settings_macros_list_help: Each one lists its harness, machine, working directory, model, effort, pool and whether it asks before running.
settings_mem_ceiling_help: RAM ceiling: new sessions on a machine wait in a queue while its memory in use would go over this ceiling, and start on their own once memory frees up. Empty means unlimited; the minimum is 1.5 GB.
settings_mem_ceiling_invalid: Enter a number of GB, or leave empty
settings_mem_ceiling_save_failed: Could not save the RAM ceiling: {error}
settings_monitoring_machines_help: Tick a machine to show its CPU, memory and disk as a small gauge in the header, green, orange or red at a glance. Every machine this instance has a daemon on is listed.
settings_nav_position_help: Where the route tabs live on a wide screen. Narrow screens always use the bottom bar.
settings_net_stats_help: What this browser has pulled from the API and the websocket since the page loaded.
settings_notify_input_help: A browser notification when a session is waiting for you.
settings_passkeys_auto_prompt_help: Server-wide. Asks for the passkey as soon as the sign-in screen opens, instead of waiting for a click. Anyone can still dismiss it and type a token.
settings_passkeys_auto_prompt_label: Always read the passkey on the sign-in screen
settings_passkeys_help: A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of your token. Your token keeps working, and stays the way back in if you lose a key.
settings_passkeys_not_discoverable: This key is not discoverable, so it will not appear on the sign-in screen.
settings_passkeys_test_help: Runs the sign-in check without signing you out.
settings_passkeys_unavailable: Passkeys are unavailable here. They need a browser that supports them and a server reachable over https.
settings_pin_first_message_help: Keep the opening user message as a sticky brief at the top of every conversation.
settings_role_tinted_background_help: Lightly colour each bubble background with its role colour (assistant, tool, user…) so a quick scroll reads the flow by colour.
settings_redaction_enable_help: Scrub tool I/O and messages as events are produced.
settings_redaction_help: Redact secrets (API keys, tokens, private keys, DB passwords) out of session events on the daemon before they are stored or broadcast. Matched spans become typed placeholders like [REDACTED:github_token]. Applies to running sessions within ~1s of saving.
settings_redaction_off_body: Agent output is stored and broadcast as-is, including any credentials that appear in tool results.
settings_redaction_patterns_hint: One regex per line, layered on the built-in detectors. Invalid patterns are rejected on save.
settings_rescrub_confirm_body: Matched values are replaced with [REDACTED:category:hash] and the originals are not recoverable.
settings_rescrub_empty: No secrets found in stored transcripts
settings_rescrub_help: Apply the current detector set to messages already stored. Preview first; nothing is written until you confirm.
settings_rescrub_preview_body: Scanned {scanned} messages, {changed} would change, {values} values would be masked.
settings_rescrub_preview_title: Preview only — nothing has been written.
settings_self_update_from_env: Currently taken from CCTUI_SELF_UPDATE_MACHINE / CCTUI_SELF_UPDATE_DIR; saving here overrides it.
settings_self_update_help: Where the “Update” button runs its agent: an enrolled machine and a working directory. That machine's own instructions say how cctui is deployed there (Kubernetes, Compose, systemd…).
settings_session_emoji_help: Prefix names generated by the agent with an emoji matching the subject. Names you typed yourself are left untouched.
settings_sessions_desc: List, spawning and conversation behaviour. The per-section sort and the label filter are set
settings_spawn_dock_help: Replace the “+ New” button with the whole new-session form, pinned to one side of the Sessions screen. On narrow screens the button and dialog come back.
settings_stats_dock_help: Pin the account usage gauges, the rolling token windows and the Overview figures to one edge of the Sessions screen. Shares a column with the new-session panel when both sit on the same edge; hidden on a narrow screen.
settings_storage_attachments_help: Files attached to unsent drafts live in this browser until the draft is sent. They are dropped automatically after 14 days, or as soon as their draft is launched, discarded or archived.
settings_subtitle: Your preferences, saved to your account.
settings_theme_help: Auto follows the system's light or dark setting and recalls the last light and dark themes you picked.
settings_toast_position_help: Which side of the screen notification toasts appear on. Only visible on a wide screen: on a narrow one the toast already spans the full width.
settings_version_check_help: The server probes GitHub for a newer release every 6 hours. Check now to ask straight away; a second check within a minute reuses the last answer.
settings_whip_guidance_hint: Shown to the model instead of the default keep-going message when a stall is blocked.
settings_whip_mode_extend_help: Extend: these are added to the built-in defaults below.
settings_whip_mode_replace_help: Replace: only these phrases are matched (defaults ignored).
settings_whip_phrases_help: One per line. Trimmed and de-duplicated on save.
spawn_account_auto_fallback_hint: Auto binds your only matching account, or falls back to the machine's own login.
spawn_account_auto_hint: Auto-binds your account "{account}" through the gateway.
spawn_account_gateway_hint: Runs through the passthrough gateway under this account.
spawn_account_none_hint: Runs on the worker's own login — no gateway, no account binding.
spawn_account_pool_hint: Bound inside the pool "{name}": the server picks a member, and only ever moves the session between members.
spawn_draft_incomplete: a draft needs a machine, a working directory and a prompt
spawn_failure_inline: The daemon could not start the session:
spawn_harness_no_credential: Account "{account}" has no {harness} credential — switch to Auto/No account or pick another account.
spawn_no_machines_hint: No machines enrolled — enroll one from the Overview page.
spawn_profile_reorder_failed: Could not save the profile order: {error}
spawn_profile_reorder_hint: Drag to reorder, or press the up and down arrow keys
spawn_prompt_history_hint: Press ↑ in the prompt to recall the last one
spawn_toast_queued: Session queued: the machine is over its RAM ceiling. It starts on its own once memory frees up.
spawn_toast_unconfirmed: Launch dispatched but not confirmed yet — check the list before retrying (a retry starts a second session)
theme_auto_help: Follows the system, with your last light and dark themes
update_agent_hint: No update hook on that machine, so a YOLO agent will work it out. Configure CCTUI_UPDATE_COMMAND to make updates deterministic.
update_changelog_empty: No release notes yet — the server has not finished its first check.
update_changelog_failed: Could not load the release notes.
update_confirm_body: An agent in YOLO mode will take over the operation. It should take a few minutes, with a short interruption. Continue?
update_confirm_body_hook: The machine will run this deployment's own update command, check that the new version answers, and roll back if it does not. It should take a few minutes, with a short interruption. Continue?
update_hook_hint: This deployment has an update hook, so no agent is involved.
update_no_target_hint: Pick the self-update machine in Settings › Instance first.
update_open_release_page: Open the release page on GitHub
update_run_phase_verifying: Waiting for the new version to answer
update_toast_launched: Update to v{version} handed to an agent
update_toast_launched_hook: Update to v{version} handed to the machine's update hook
usage_notices_help: Tell running sessions, in their next turn, each time this account crosses another step of a 5h, weekly or per-model usage window (percentage, soft-limit cap, reset time and countdown) so an orchestrator can pace itself. Off by default.
users_admin_token_note: The admin token is server-wide and owns no machines or accounts — OAuth accounts are created under a user.
users_api_keys_help: Mint scoped tokens (e.g. a dispatch-only key for automation). Scopes are editable in place — the secret is never re-minted to re-scope. New grants are clamped to the ceiling above.
users_confirm_delete_token: Delete this token? It is revoked and removed in one step.
users_confirm_purge_user: Permanently delete {name}? This cannot be undone.
users_confirm_revoke_key: Revoke key {key}? It stops working immediately.
users_confirm_revoke_machine: Revoke this machine? Its key stops working; the daemon must re-enroll.
users_confirm_revoke_user: Revoke {name}? ALL their user tokens and machine keys stop working permanently. To turn a user off temporarily, use the active toggle instead.
users_machine_hint: Leave blank to use the machine's reported hostname.
users_machines_help: Machines enrolled to this user — each connects with its own machine key.
users_scope_admin_required: Admin scope required to edit the ceiling
users_scopes_ceiling_help: The capabilities this user may delegate to its keys. A key's effective authority is its grant intersected with this ceiling — removing a scope here immediately limits every key.
users_secret_warning: Copy this now — it is shown only once and cannot be retrieved later.
users_tokens_help: Bearer tokens that authenticate API and CLI requests as this user.
spawn_fast_hint: 1.5x speed, increased usage. Same model, same quality.
home_sessions_periods_hint: Local time · week starts Monday · archived sessions included
attachments_compression_failed: Could not compress “{name}”. This browser may not support the format. Try another image.
